slides.texte_overlay:
uncomfortable things to do alone
to overcome fear of being judged

eat alone at a busy restaurant

no phone, no book.

ask a stranger to take your photo

then say thank you properly.

try a new exercise in the
middle of the gym

everyone started somewhere.

learn something new and share it

even if you're still learning.

use a micro-learning app
like the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
sing one song at karaoke

badly. proudly.
